question: Should the Gateway-validated plugin descriptor model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431 become the supported contract for node-hosted agent tools?
rationale: The capability is clearly missing and the candidate is technically proven, but approving a permanent plugin API that lets connected-node commands enter the model-visible execution surface requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Refresh and adopt
options.body: Resolve current-main conflicts while preserving Gateway-known descriptors, node provenance, dynamic lifecycle invalidation, and existing command policy.

options.title: Narrow then adopt
options.body: Retain dynamic node tools but reduce descriptor fields or invocation eligibility before selecting the permanent API.

options.title: Keep wrapper plugins
options.body: Decline dynamic node registration and continue supporting named tools through wrapper plugins plus the generic `nodes` tool.

recommendation.title: Refresh and adopt
recommendation.body: Resolve current-main conflicts while preserving Gateway-known descriptors, node provenance, dynamic lifecycle invalidation, and existing command policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and proved the direct candidate and has the strongest available history on the affected node execution paths.
